1343|5751dde2.name: Mountaineer Stormpike
1343|5751dde2.text:
Well, if it isn't a young, bristling $c, no doubt drawn here by talk of my exploits in fields of battle!

No time for stories now, for there are great, important deeds that need doing!  So if you're looking for glory, then luck shines on you today...

257597|32ab8342.name: Bruegs Kindleborn
257597|32ab8342.text: Out of the hottest fire comes the strongest steel.

257597|879e41ad.name: Bruegs Kindleborn
257597|879e41ad.text: To give light, one must burn.

257808|c24ef564.name: Braldir Ashmantle
257808|c24ef564.text: You have proven worthy of the sapta of fire and warrant the attention of the spirits. They will test you once you have sought them out. The only thing left for you to do is approach the mountain top.

6734|b63e4e81.name: Innkeeper Hearthstove
6734|b63e4e81.text: Fill yer tankard and pull up a chair. We've stories to tell and kegs to empty.

267-progress.name: Captain Rugelfuss
267-progress.text: Do you have 8 Trogg Stone Teeth to show me?  If not, there is still work to be done, $N.
267-progress.title: The Trogg Threat

307-progress.name: Mountaineer Stormpike
307-progress.text: Do you have that Miners' Gear, $N?
307-progress.title: Filthy Paws

94466-progress.name: Braldir Ashmantle
94466-progress.text: Aye, I've near all I need for the fire sapta, $N--just missin' the fire tar and the seer's pouch. The tar's carried by Tunnel Rat Geomancers in the kobold caves up north. The pouch ye'll need to wrest from a Stonesplinter seer in the southern hills. These ingredients are bound to flame, as all true saptas must be. Their elemental ties make our craft strong.
94466-progress.title: Call of Fire

94467-progress.name: Braldir Ashmantle
94467-progress.text:
The brazier stands about a third your height, with charred inscriptions along its smooth metal rails. The metal shows no signs of wear from the weather, and the bowl seated at the top of it feels cool to the touch. 

Blackrock Mountain looms in the distance, in clear view to honor from this sacred place.
94467-progress.title: Call of Fire

94468-progress.name: Bruegs Kindleborn
94468-progress.text: Aye, $N? What do ye have there?
94468-progress.title: Call of Fire

94473-complete.name: Braldir Ashmantle
94473-complete.text:
May fire burn within your heart, $N.

The elements await you.
94473-complete.title: Fire Sapta
